classification.rationale: The Marzocchi units are gear pumps that can be run in reverse as motors. Under Section XVI note 3 the principal function is pumping, and speed, suction and displacement are critical pump characteristics. CBP classified identical Marzocchi Pompe gear units in 8413.60.0030 as hydraulic fluid power gear pumps (N361506, in force). The code is 8413.60.00.30.
